implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/approvals/ApprovalDetailModal.tsx: Modal overlay (similar pattern to CommandPalette). Opens when approval card is clicked. Content: (1) Job context: type, topic, capabilities as badges, metadata as formatted JSON (in pre block — no dangerouslySetInnerHTML for XSS safety). (2) Safety explain: matched rule, decision reason, eval path. (3) Similar past approvals: 'Last approved Xh ago by [actor]' if available from history API. (4) Approve button (success variant) with optional comment textarea. (5) Reject button (danger variant) with required reason textarea (Zod validation: reason min 1 char). On action: call useApproveJob() or useRejectJob() mutation, show success/error feedback, close modal, list auto-refreshes via cache invalidation.
implementationPlan.note: Created ApprovalDetailModal with job context display (badges + JSON pre), safety decision section (matched rule + reason), history section, approve with optional comment, reject with required reason, success/error feedback, auto-close on success.

implementationPlan.description: Wire ApprovalDetailModal into ApprovalsPage.tsx: click card sets selectedApprovalId, opens modal. Modal onClose clears selection.
